links.outcome: Recognition of suicidal ideation in text (precision, recall) on held-out test set, including threshold trade-off
links.effect: Precision 0.91, recall 0.92, specificity 0.92, F1 0.91, accuracy 0.92; stricter threshold raised precision to 0.98 but lowered recall to 0.34.
links.quote: On the held-out test set, it achieved precision 0.91, recall 0.92, specificity 0.92, F1 0.91, and accuracy 0.92.

unlisted_practices: Auditable anchor-based decision layer separated from encoder using expert-curated reference statements
Two-threshold workflow: high-confidence detections trigger immediate response, intermediate scores prompt clarification and re-evaluation
Lightweight model chosen over large generative LLMs for computational efficiency

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI-based suicidal ideation detection safeguard designed for deployment in a student mental health chatbot, assessing threshold calibration and escalation pathways.
